prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: check your DMs please thanks
Delta: Hi, Joshua. My apologies for any confusion. Allow me a few minutes to review your reservation. *HJH

Customer: Only pretzels in Comfort Plus ATL to ALB today. No snack tray. Wonder if that is normal. 0
Delta: My apologies for that. Please reach out to the flight crew to see if they have any other choices please.  *HRO

Customer: hoping for a upgrade on my flight. Lots of empty seats and the flight attendants won't let me move up to a comfort plus seat. #DL2042
Delta: 2/2 https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: check in is down at  - what happens now? https://t.co/QbOr3AyRqQ
Delta: Oh no! Do you need any assistance with your reservation? *AMV

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: rebooking_change):
"""for some reason still checked in.  Please check out so i can check back in and get my comfort plus and first.class upgrades"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: Hi, we can help with that. Please DM us your reservation number so we can look into checking you out and exploring upgrade options.
